definition: a person or company that owns a home and rents it to others
example: I emailed my landlord about the broken heater, but he hasn't replied yet.

definition: a person who pays rent to live in a place
example: Tenants in this building must give one month's notice before moving out.

definition: to sign a legal contract for renting a home for a period of time
example: Before you sign a lease, read the section about pets and parking carefully.

definition: money paid to a landlord at the start of a rental, returned later if there is no damage
example: The landlord returned my full security deposit because the apartment was spotless.

definition: a rise in the amount of rent a tenant pays
example: BC limits the annual rent increase a landlord can charge for most rental units.

definition: basic services for a home such as electricity, heat, water and gas
vi: các tiện ích sinh hoạt (điện, nước, ga, sưởi)
example: The rent is $1,900 a month, and utilities are included except for internet.

definition: a formal request asking a building manager to fix something
vi: yêu cầu sửa chữa, bảo trì
example: I submitted a maintenance request online, but nobody has come to fix the leak.
collocations: follow up on a maintenance request

definition: to leave the home where you live and take your things with you
vi: dọn ra, chuyển đi (khỏi nơi ở)
example: We plan to move out at the end of June when our lease expires.

definition: to officially tell someone in advance that you will leave or end an agreement
vi: báo trước (việc dọn đi, chấm dứt hợp đồng thuê)
example: You must give notice in writing at least one full month before you leave the unit.

definition: a separate apartment on the lowest floor of a house, common in BC
vi: căn hộ tầng hầm (cho thuê riêng)
example: We rented a two-bedroom basement suite in Burnaby because it was cheaper than a condo.

definition: a monthly fee condo owners in BC pay for shared building costs
vi: phí quản lý chung cư (phí strata)
example: The strata fee covers snow removal, building insurance and the gym.

definition: a person or company hired to run a rental building for the owner
vi: người/công ty quản lý bất động sản
example: The property manager said the elevator would be repaired by Friday.

definition: a person who shares a home with you
vi: bạn cùng phòng, người ở ghép
example: Living with a roommate helped me save money during my first year in Vancouver.

definition: already containing furniture
example: The studio is fully furnished, so you only need to bring your clothes.

definition: having a lot of room or space
example: The townhouse has a spacious living room and a small backyard for the kids.

definition: uncomfortably small and crowded
example: Our old apartment felt cramped after the baby was born.

definition: an area of a town or city and the people who live there
example: We chose this neighbourhood because it has good schools and a quiet park.

definition: a report that someone is making too much noise
example: After a noise complaint from the unit below, we put rugs on our hardwood floors.

definition: work done to repair and improve a building
vi: sự cải tạo, sửa sang (nhà cửa)
example: The lobby will be closed during the renovation, so please use the side entrance.

definition: water escaping from a pipe, roof or appliance where it should not
example: A water leak from the upstairs bathroom damaged our kitchen ceiling.

definition: the removal of insects or animals such as mice from a building
vi: diệt côn trùng, kiểm soát sinh vật gây hại
example: The landlord called pest control after tenants reported mice in the laundry room.

definition: homes that people with low or average incomes can afford
example: The city council approved a plan to build 500 units of affordable housing near the SkyTrain.

definition: the first part of the price you pay when buying a home with a loan
example: It took us six years to save enough for a down payment on a condo.

definition: a home or room that is empty and available to rent
example: Vancouver's low vacancy rate makes it hard to find an apartment.

definition: to rent your rented home to another person for a time
vi: cho thuê lại (nhà mình đang thuê)
example: You need the landlord's written permission to sublet your apartment while you travel.

definition: a washer and dryer inside your own apartment
vi: máy giặt, máy sấy riêng trong căn hộ
example: I'm willing to pay a little more for a place with in-suite laundry.

definition: allowing or welcoming pets
example: It's hard to find a pet-friendly rental in this city if you have a large dog.

definition: close enough to walk to
vi: trong khoảng cách đi bộ được
example: The apartment is within walking distance of a grocery store and two bus stops.
collocations: within walking distance of the station

definition: to legally force someone to leave the home they rent
vi: đuổi (người thuê) ra khỏi nhà, cưỡng chế dọn đi
example: A landlord cannot evict a tenant without following the proper legal process.

definition: electrical machines used at home, such as a fridge or stove
example: All appliances in the kitchen were replaced last year, including the dishwasher.

definition: a time when a home for sale is open for anyone to visit
vi: buổi mở cửa cho xem nhà
example: We went to three open houses on Sunday, but none had enough parking.

definition: to move to a smaller home
example: After their children moved out, my parents decided to downsize to a two-bedroom condo.

definition: a person who owns the home they live in
vi: chủ sở hữu nhà, người có nhà riêng
example: As a first-time homeowner, I didn't expect so many maintenance costs.

definition: to repair or improve a place
example: We bought an older house and spent the summer fixing up the kitchen.

definition: useful features or services in a building or area, such as a gym or park
vi: tiện ích, tiện nghi (khu nhà, khu vực)
example: The building's amenities include a rooftop garden, a gym and bike storage.
